description.text: This program is to help student gain knowledge and ability of business management, economic management and enterprise management, and enable student to deal with all kinds of business management related work in all kinds of organizations. Major Courses:Principles of Management,micro-economics,macro-economics,Management Information System,Statistics, Accounting, Finance Management, Marketing,Economic Law,Human Resource Management,Enterprise Strategic Management"

duration.text: The Business Administration at University of Science and Technology Beijing is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3236 USD/per year ￥ 23300 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7. A letter from a sponsor

requirements.text: 1. With age under 25 2. Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 3. HSK level 3
